verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an optional AI plugin providing a built-in LLM chat window that can be linked to a session for 'context-aware help' and to 'run commands on your behalf,' which partially matches the story, but documentation is a single sentence with no detail on inline NL-to-command generation workflow, and community reaction focused on privacy/opt-in controversy rather than confirming the generation quality. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the inline command-generation UX, independent hands-on validation that the right shell command is reliably produced, and resolution of the reported opt-in/toggle bug's effect on trust.
